Python S3 Batch Uploader

A robust, recursive solution to upload entire local directories to AWS S3 using boto3.

warning Prerequisites

Before running the code, ensure you have the AWS SDK for Python installed and configured.

# 1. Install Boto3

pip install boto3


# 2. Configure Credentials (AWS CLI)

aws configure

Why this script?

This script uses os.walk to traverse subdirectories, mirroring your local folder structure in the S3 bucket automatically.
